trap.label: tag fixa
trap.wrong: They want to join, isn’t it?
trap.right: They want to join, don’t they?
trap.why: O brasileiro usa uma tag única, como “né?”. Em inglês a tag muda conforme sujeito e auxiliar.

fix.wrong: It is too fast, doesn’t it?
fix.right: It is too fast, isn’t it?
fix.why: Frase com be pede tag com be.
Never já é negativo; tag positiva.

fix.wrong: We can try, can’t we not?

rewrite.prompt: Acrescente uma tag: “It is too fast.”
rewrite.answer: It is too fast, isn’t it?
